turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I have an interview on Thursday and I'm really nervous.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's normal, we can practice. Do you want to start with tell me about yourself, or with questions about your weaknesses?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a second, my roommate wants to ask me something. I'll let you know when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam, does this essay make sense? I've read it so many times the words look fake.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hand it over. How long is it supposed to be?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two thousand words. I'm at two thousand four hundred.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: This whole paragraph about the history of the factory, do you need it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe not. I just found it interesting.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then cut it. Your argument starts on page two, it should start on page one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh. You're right, but it hurts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, continue, what did the landlord say next?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: He said the boiler's our problem.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. We were picking which interview question to practice first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Weaknesses. That one always trips me up.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good choice. Pick a real weakness, then explain what you're doing to improve it. Honesty plus progress works best.
